scope: Numerical boundary diagnostic against supplied rational model, not physical truth or benchmark superiority
construction: Scalar B=scale; max integral=3/2; target=scale*(3/2+offset). Both floating solvers default absolute tolerance 1e-8; exact rational solver classifies declared target. Conversion error recorded exactly as Fraction.from_float of B/target. No random seeds or timing objective.
development: Separate B=3, target=3 with exact integral 1, tests generation and exception capture; evaluation scale/offset grid never exercised before publication
primary: All 15 grid rows: exact declared-model status versus float solver status. Distinguish rational mathematical membership from tolerance-accepted floating primal_checked. Do not call all disagreements implementation defects.
secondary: Floating returned terminal and actuator/slew residuals; reconstructed controls exact binary-float rational replay against declared rational data; solver exceptions retained; B/target float conversion deltas retained
failure_rule: Catch/report floating solver exceptions without dropping rows; exact oracle exception aborts. No retries/tolerance tuning/post-freeze changes without new version disclosure.
limitations: 1D square model only, fixed prescribed cases, no author-blind holdout, no hardware precision or physiological calibration, rational exactness does not validate source measurement
resources: One BLAS/OMP thread externally set, CPU scipy/numpy, no training/download/GPU; budget documented not enforced
